title: Unit Delay
text: Delay signal one sample period, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial condition} sets First sample period output; {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the discrete interval between sample time hits, {State name} sets the unique name for block state and {State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} sets the option to require that state names resolve to signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial condition
params.values: First sample period output 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Specify sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Discrete interval between sample time hits -1 (default) | 1-by-2 vector

params.name: State name
params.values: Unique name for block state ’’ (default) | alphanumeric string

params.name: State name must resolve to Simulink signal object
params.values: Option to require that state names resolve to signal object off (default) | on
